cards.task: Add a rework checkbox to tasks created under an issue, defaulting to checked, editable per task by the TL or PM.
cards.evidence: By default, let it be a rework, but the TL or the project manager can make it not a rework.
cards.next_step: Add the rework checkbox to the task creation form in the Issues module, default checked, with TL/PM override per task.
cards.basis: Sreekumar's rework checkbox decision in this meeting

decisions.decision: The rework checkbox on a task defaults to checked (assumed rework); the TL or project manager can uncheck it for a specific task when the issue stems from another module or external dependency.
decisions.evidence: By default, let it be a rework, but the TL or the project manager can make it not a rework.

decisions.decision: An issue can be raised without a task, but a task must be created before that issue can actually be fixed or closed.
decisions.evidence: Issue can be raised without any task, but ideally once you want to fix that issue, there should be some task.

decisions.decision: Going forward, PMO will publish a weekly plan every Monday showing planned activities for the week, instead of reporting only after completion.
decisions.evidence: I want you to publish a weekly plan going forward from every Monday.

threads.note: Sreekumar questioned the value of having a PMO if the team just follows whatever it says without a plan; possible process or role review ahead.
threads.evidence: Otherwise, I don't need a PMO in this, right?
